text: The journey of this demo ends here, I am afraid.
zh: 恐怕这段试玩版的旅程就到此为止了。

text: It seems like you missed to help the wizard.
zh: 看来你错过了帮助巫师的机会。

text: Maybe, you should turn around and look for that old man.
zh: 也许你该掉头回去找找那位老人。

text: I hope you had fun playing Pale Coins.
zh: 希望你玩 Pale Coins 玩得开心。

text: Also, this version is only a small teaser, so there's plenty of room for improvement.
zh: 另外，这个版本只是一个小小的预览，还有很大的改进空间。

text: If you want to give feedback, feel free to drop a comment.
zh: 如果你想提供反馈，欢迎留言评论。

text: Hey, here's the developer taking control of this NPC.
zh: 嘿，我是开发者，现在暂时接管这个NPC。

text: But only for this short message.
If you like the game so far, you could check out the page on https://lukasirzl.itch.io/pale-coins to stay up to date.
zh: 如果你目前喜欢这款游戏，可以访问 https://lukasirzl.itch.io/pale-coins 关注最新动态。

text: I'd really appreciate every form of feedback.
zh: 任何形式的反馈我都感激不尽。

text: Stay tuned and have a great day!
I passed out for a while.
